name: grimvalor
features: built-in 4:3 UI, intro, and menu selection
native Camera.aspect gameplay and cinematic behavior retained
game analytics initialization, queueing, sending, and update paths disabled
known_limitations: The 4:3 result is structurally verified but has not yet been visually verified on the target device.
A real 4:3 Android framebuffer is required; the UI selector does not create a 4:3 viewport inside a widescreen framebuffer.

compatibility.strategy: exact tested arm64 library plus ELF mapping, complete unique method signatures, canonical SHA-256, and final patched hash
notes: A partially completed audited library is safe to finish because patched instructions are canonicalized back to the exact source hash.
The shared optional branding cleanup remains responsible for recognized APKVision runtime wrappers.
Billing, purchases, cloud saves, authentication, achievements, and Play Games are preserved.
